title: Virtual mouse brain histology from multi-contrast MRI via deep learning.
summary: Held-out mouse samples and co-registered histology comparisons showed predicted maps tracked tissue patterns and distinguished shiverer from control tissue. This is an ex vivo mouse proof of concept limited by tissue, sample and MRI-resolution conditions; it does not establish human in-vivo histology. The recorded date is the first located result-bearing version (2020-05-03); the eLife article is the later journal version.
ai_technology: A convolutional neural network mapped multi-contrast mouse-brain MRI signals to predicted histology-related contrasts.
